metadata.summary: Jitin ordered a Protein Breakfast Wrap from Manhattan Bagel

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I want to order protein breakfast wrap.
One Protein Breakfast Wrap. First things first, I'll need to get a wrap choice for that. We have Flour or Wheat. Which one would you like?
Do protein wrap has modifications. Can you please check it first?

Let me check the Protein Breakfast Wrap for you. It comes with Grilled Chicken, Egg Whites, Spinach, Avocado, Roasted Red Peppers, and Melted Swiss Cheese, all served on a whole wheat wrap. There are no modifications available for this item. Would you like to add it to your order or would you like to hear more options?
